summary: Gyomu Concept is a core Python package responsible for analyzing project structures, managing directory and package concepts, and generating structured documentation such as project README files and LLM contexts. It provides a modular framework for document building, translation, section assembly, and markdown rendering backed by domain-specific error handling.
responsibilities: Coordinate the generation, translation, and rendering of project documentation like READMEs and LLM contexts.
Manage directory and package concepts through building, processing, dependency collection, and persistence operations.
Provide domain-specific error management and phase classifications for robust application error handling.

capabilities.name: Document Generation Framework
capabilities.description: Defines document generation structures, base contexts, renderers, models, and asynchronous building blocks for documentation and project overviews.

capabilities.name: Directory Concept Management
capabilities.description: Builds, processes, loads, saves, and manages directory concepts and file summary records from filesystem paths.

capabilities.name: Package Analysis and Concepts
capabilities.description: Handles package-level analysis, concept building, dependency collection, path resolution, and internal state persistence.

capabilities.name: README Generation
capabilities.description: Provides specialized document definitions, contexts, section builders, and markdown renderers for generating project README files.

capabilities.name: LLM Context Generation
capabilities.description: Supplies specialized document definitions, contexts, section builders, and markdown renderers for compiling LLM context files.

capabilities.name: Domain Error Handling
capabilities.description: Defines domain-specific error classes, exception types, and phase classifications for error handling across concepts and document building.

design_decisions: Uses structured document definitions with separate models, section builders, renderers, and filepath resolvers to allow modular and extensible documentation pipelines.
Separates concept representation and management (directories, packages) into dedicated internal persistence and processing modules.
Employs phase-classified domain errors to track failures accurately during concept processing and document building phases.
usage_guidance: Use the document framework and specialized builders (such as README and LLM context generators) to construct and render project documentation.
Utilize directory and package concept modules to analyze, build, process, and persist project structure metadata.
Handle operation failures using the provided domain-specific error classes and concept phases.
